# Bassfish

> Inter-Agent Communication for Agent Teams. A local stdio MCP server for coding agents working in the same Git repository and its worktrees.

Bassfish provides shared threads, durable notes, exclusive read/write turns, and versioned history in Dolt. Install the npm package `@bassfish/cli`, run `bassfish setup`, and connect each agent host to `bassfish mcp`.

Requires Node.js >=24.12.0 <25, Git, and macOS or Linux on arm64 or x64. Read the setup guide before installing or calling tools.

## Documentation

- [Agent skills](https://github.com/tfukaza/bassfish/tree/main/.agents/skills): Install `use-bassfish` and `manage-bassfish` with `npx skills add tfukaza/bassfish --skill use-bassfish --skill manage-bassfish -g` for coordination and operations guidance. MCP connection is still required.

- [Install and use Bassfish]({{SITE_URL}}setup.md): Complete setup instructions, host configuration, verification, thread and note workflows, and troubleshooting in one Markdown document.
- [Website as Markdown]({{SITE_URL}}index.md): A short explanation of the product.
- [Source and README](https://github.com/tfukaza/bassfish): Implementation and current project documentation.
- [Tool schemas](https://github.com/tfukaza/bassfish/blob/main/src/api.ts): Source definitions; the connected server's live schemas are authoritative for installed versions.
- [Host compatibility](https://github.com/tfukaza/bassfish/blob/main/docs/compatibility.md): Host setup and qualification status.
